question: Under which section of the Mental Healthcare Act 2017 is every person with mental illness guaranteed the right to live in the community and to be treated in the least restrictive environment?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. Section 115 of the Mental Healthcare Act 2017 explicitly guarantees the right to live in and be part of the community and to receive treatment in the least restrictive setting possible.
Section 18 deals with the right to access mental healthcare — important, but it does not specifically address the right to community living.
Section 21 covers rights regarding quality of care within facilities; the community-living right is in a different section.
Section 89 relates to supported admission procedures. The community-living provision is elsewhere in the Act.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review the NMHP/DMHP and Mental Healthcare Act 2017 content block. The right to community living is enshrined in a specific section you should be able to cite.
Well done. Section 115 is a landmark provision shifting India's mental health framework toward community-based, rights-affirming care.
